lines.text: Four cameras, four matches. Every screen in the building shows your face. Laci is waiting at the next corner: "The police are on their way." While he argues with the dispatcher, you slip back into the dark.

Friday, 22:58. Platán School, Room 214. Digital Culture Night: pizza, a film, sleeping bags on the lab floor. Ms Varga has gone down to the car park for the spare sleeping bags. Everyone else is asleep.
They say thanks, then ask for another one, "a better one this time". You cannot take back the first one: it is on their phone now, and you do not know who they really are.
Look at the corner: "PanoMap · street view · 2026". It's a picture from an online map that anyone can open. He wasn't at your stop. He only knows which stop it is.
It isn't you. Prove it: take the video apart (Frames, Sound), find where every piece came from (Search, Mail), then report it and tell Ms Varga. School starts at 8.
That was your mother. She… she had an accident with the car. A woman is hurt. The police want bail tonight, 900,000, or she goes to prison. A lawyer is coming at midnight for the money.
Check what? It was her, I know my own daughter's voice! …She was crying. I can't sit down, I have to find the money. The biscuit tins. Your grandfather never trusted banks.
Bence's mum called me. I saw it. I know it isn't you, sweetheart. Nobody who knows you would believe it. Do what Ms Varga says, and call me at break.
Oh God. My poor Anyu. Listen: nobody opens that door. Not for anyone. Don't give anybody any money. If someone comes, call 112. Put Nagyi on, please.
I've seen the video. Before you say anything: I know what you're like, and I also know what can be faked. Come to Room 214 before first lesson. Bring anything that helps. – Varga
Exactly. Paying tells them we're a school that pays, and there's no guarantee anyway. I'm calling the head and the police, and on Monday we report it to the national cyber security centre.
Memory from yesterday, 23:04: "…scared of the dark…". Would you like to hear it again?
Are you sure? Check the times in the activity logs.

lines.text: I'm leaving Réka's now, home in 15 min. texting mum too. you did the right thing telling me
hey, I was mean in the group yesterday. I deleted it. sorry, it was not okay.
I see you read everything one in the group and you're safe
White trainers. A backpack. Taller than you. And you were in Screen 3 at half six? …This thing beeps at every red hoodie in Budapest. Last week it matched a mannequin.
And one more thing. Some kid at the bus stop was filming the screens through the glass. Your face on every one of them. …I'd keep an eye on that.
A virus? On the computers? …I don't know computers, kid. I know boilers. The basement door sticks: push hard. I'll go and get Ms Varga out of that lift.
Nothing? With every screen in the school screaming red? …Go on, tell Ms Varga. I'll be at the lift.

lines.text: This is the police cyber unit. Your IP address was used in a crime. To avoid a fine, tell me the login code for the family bank app, and do not tell your parents.
